messages:
scan-bot: [supplychain-scan] IMAGE registry.redwood.internal/runtime/prod:sha256:7f3a detected HIGH severity vulnerability CVE-2025-2786 in transitive package 'config-parse-utils' (via net-lib@2.4.1 -> config-parse-utils@0.9.0). SBOM path attached. https://scans.redwood.internal/scan/1718502345 :rotating_light:

maya: saw this. thanks scan-bot. is this runtime image currently in prod?

harry: yes, that digest is in the canary pool and one prod node. low traffic but not zero.

maya: ok. immediate containment: can we mark the image as quarantined in registry and start a rollback to previous stable digest? @oncall-sre

oncall-sre: initiating quarantine tag now: `quarantine/1718502345`. pulling previous stable digest and scheduling drain of canary node. ETA ~15m.

leena: what are the exploitability details? is it RCE or local? I see CVSS 8.1 but need more context before telling customers.

samir: looks like remote-ish via crafted payload in deserialization path. exploit requires untrusted input to hit net-lib parsing endpoint — should be medium risk for us, but high for worker-facing ingestion path.

maya: good call. mitigations: 1) quarantine image, 2) block deploys from that pipeline, 3) rebuild image with patched dependency, 4) verify image signature with KMS, 5) ensure audit log entry for all actions.

harry: blocking deploys from pipeline now (ci-policy:deny-on-high). I added a temporary RBAC change to CI service account to prevent new pushes until we flip the flag. CC: @leena for audit requirements.

leena: on audit: create explicit event via `auditctl` and push to long-term retention. Also need to record who triggered quarantine and RBAC override. auditor-bot, can you ingest these events?

auditor-bot: Received request. Please annotate events with keys: {"incident_id":"SC-2025-1718502345","initiator":"harry"}. Ingest scheduled.

samir: quick rebuild plan: update package lock to pin config-parse-utils@0.9.1 (patched), run `make image-build` in staging, run full e2e and image-scan hook, push signed image back to registry. I can take the rebuild if devex gives green light.

maya: samir pls proceed. when you push the rebuild, sign with key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build-keys/cryptoKeys/image-signer` and include SBOM. leena, do we need KMS key rotation?

leena: no rotation yet. we should verify that the signing key has not been exposed and that access logs show only CI service account used. If anything funky, rotate. I'll pull KMS access logs and check CMKs.

samir: starting rebuild in staging now. build command: ```bash
./ci/scripts/build_image.sh --tag staging-rebuild-1718502345
```

harry: registry quarantine tag in place, old digest pulled off canary. adding note in incident tracker SC-2025-1718502345.

maya: also notify Legal/Compliance if customer data might have been affected. Samir, keep the unpatched image offline and don't delete the digest until audit sign-off.

samir: got it. preserves old digest locally, won't delete. staging build passed smoke tests, running full scan.

scan-bot: staging image staging-rebuild-1718502345 scanned: no findings for CVE-2025-2786. SBOM updated.

leena: KMS access logs show only CI service account `ci-builder@redwood` used during signing. no anomalous principals. I'll attach log excerpt to the tracker.

maya: good. next steps: 1) schedule canary rollout of signed rebuild, 2) update ops runbook with this CVE note, 3) postmortem and dependency hygiene action items (lockfile audits, transitive monitoring). who owns postmortem?

harry: I'll own postmortem and coordinate with eng-sre and product-security. aiming for draft in 48h.

oncall-sre: canary rollout scheduled in 30m. will watch latency and error rates; rollback on alarms.

auditor-bot: Audit record created: incident_id=SC-2025-1718502345, actions=[quarantine_tag, rbaco_override, rebuild_signed, kms_check], retention=7y.

maya: thanks all. add retrospective item: add a registry webhook to auto-signal when SBOM shows transitive matches for high CVEs.

samir: copying notes to the internal ticket and closing this thread once canary stable.

maya: closing thread here. follow up in #postmortems once harry shares draft.
